name: Energy shield impact
description: A shot stops against a personal energy shield. The field behaves like a huge thin glass bowl: at 0 ms it is struck and rings with a wobbling, beating hum (two detuned sets of modes), but a ring modulator turns that ring electric and wrong. 0 to 250 ms: the surface crackles where it was hit as the charge spreads. A soft low 'bwom' is the field flexing inward and recovering over 300 ms.

tracks.note: The shield as an object: a glass bowl 2 m wide, its modes beating. The ring modulator keeps some of the bowl and adds inharmonic sidebands, so it is glassy but not glass.
The field bowing in and springing back: the weight of the hit. A buzzing low tone, not a clean sine.
The charge spreading across the surface from the point of impact.

controls.label: Shield size
controls.hint: A wrist buckler to a ship's deflector: lower, longer ring.

controls.label: Hit force
controls.hint: A glancing pebble to a cannon round: harder, brighter, with more flex.

controls.label: Charge
controls.hint: Nearly plain glass to a fully electric, alien clang.

controls.label: Wobble
controls.hint: A steady ring to a fast shimmering flutter.

controls.label: Crackle
controls.hint: Surface discharge: none to a shower.
